behavior: During an exit animation, no focusable content is under `aria-hidden`, and the focus is not in the closing popup. `Combobox.Popup`, `Dialog.Popup` and `Drawer.Popup` stop their focus manager when the popup closes, so their focus guards, which have `aria-hidden`, go at the close, and the focus returns at the close. This is also true while `preventUnmountOnClose()` keeps a dialog mounted. Base UI stops the focus manager when the popup unmounts.
